description_en: Queries the commercial edition rights accessible to the current caller identity by using paging. Use this operation to select rights before activation. After you call ActiveRights, you can query the processing results by using RightsActiveStatus, RightsActiveFailureCause, and RightsResourceId
description_zh: 分页查询当前调用身份可访问的商业版权益。激活前用于选择权益；调用 ActiveRights 后，通过 RightsActiveStatus、RightsActiveFailureCause 和 RightsResourceId 查询处理结果
name: ListRights

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Do not specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, pass the NextToken value returned from the previous page exactly as it was returned. The example is for illustration purposes only. Do not construct the token manually
parameters.help_zh: 分页凭证。首次查询不传；后续原样传入上一页返回的 NextToken。示例仅用于说明，不可自行构造凭证
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results per page. Specify a positive integer from 1 to 200
parameters.help_zh: 每页结果数量；建议传入 1 至 200 的正整数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The rights specification code. Refer to the rights query results for the actual value
parameters.help_zh: 权益规格编码，以权益查询结果为准
parameters.name: rights_spec

parameters.help_en: The rights activation status. Use the returned value to determine whether the activation is complete
parameters.help_zh: 权益激活状态，以返回值判断是否完成激活
parameters.name: rights_active_status

parameters.help_en: The end user to whom the rights are assigned. For convenience accounts, use EndUserId
parameters.help_zh: 权益分配的终端用户。便捷账号使用 EndUserId
parameters.name: rights_assigned_user

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource associated with the rights. This value is returned after the resource is created
parameters.help_zh: 权益关联的资源 ID；资源创建完成后返回
parameters.name: rights_resource_id

parameters.help_en: The field by which to sort the results, such as gmtCreate, rightsId, or rightsExpireTime. If you do not specify this parameter, the default sorting order of the server is used
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，例如 gmtCreate、rightsId、rightsExpireTime。不指定时按服务端默认排序
parameters.name: order_field

parameters.help_en: The sorting order. Valid values: asc and desc (lowercase). Use this parameter together with OrderField
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向，取值 asc 或 desc（小写），配合 OrderField 使用
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The rights resource type. Use Desktop for regular cloud computers. For other commodities, specify the actual rights type
parameters.help_zh: 权益资源类型。普通云电脑使用 Desktop；其他商品按权益实际类型传入
parameters.name: rights_resource_type

parameters.help_en: Optional AI rights filter. Set to true to query only AI rights, or false to query only regular rights, including historical unmarked rights. If you do not specify this parameter, all rights are queried
parameters.help_zh: 可选 AI 权益筛选：true 仅查询 AI，false 仅查询普通（含历史未标记权益），不传查询全部
parameters.name: ai_desktop

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the rights apply to regions outside the Chinese mainland, including Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China). Valid values:
0: The Chinese mainland.
1: Regions outside the Chinese mainland, including Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China)
parameters.help_zh: 是否为海外及港澳台权益：0 表示中国内地，1 表示海外及港澳台
parameters.name: overseas

parameters.help_en: The list of rights resource types to filter
parameters.help_zh: 权益资源类型筛选列表
parameters.name: rights_resource_types

parameters.help_en: The list of rights IDs to query or activate. Specify the RightsId values returned by ListRights
parameters.help_zh: 待查询或激活的权益 ID 列表。填写 ListRights 返回的 RightsId
parameters.name: rights_ids

parameters.help_en: The scenario code for the commercial edition
parameters.name: business_scene_code

schema.description_en: The API response, which includes the request ID and processing results
schema.description_zh: 接口响应，包含请求标识和处理结果

Data.description_en: The list of rights on the current page

AddDataDiskSize.description_en: The size of the additional data cloud disk. Unit: GiB
AddDataDiskSize.description_zh: 额外数据盘容量，单位 GiB

AddRootDiskSize.description_en: The size of the additional system cloud disk. Unit: GiB
AddRootDiskSize.description_zh: 额外系统盘容量，单位 GiB

AiDesktop.description_en:
Indicates whether the cloud computer is an AI cloud computer. Valid values:
true: AI cloud computer.
false: Regular cloud computer
AiDesktop.description_zh: 是否为 AI 云电脑，true 为 AI，false 为普通云电脑

BusinessSceneCode.description_en: The scenario code for the commercial edition

CalculatingCode.description_en: The compute plan code. Refer to the actual returned value of the rights
CalculatingCode.description_zh: 计算套餐编码，以权益实际返回值为准

DataDiskSize.description_en: The size of the data cloud disk. Unit: GiB

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the rights record was created. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format and ends with Z
GmtCreate.description_zh: 权益记录创建时间。采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 结尾

Hibernate.description_en: The hibernation options for the rights. The actual policy is determined in combination with the compute plan
Hibernate.description_zh: 权益休眠相关选项；实际策略结合计算套餐判断

MonthlyCredit.description_en: The monthly credit information corresponding to the rights. This value may be empty if this configuration is not available
MonthlyCredit.description_zh: 权益对应的每月积分信息；无此配置时可能为空

Overseas.description_en:
Specifies whether the rights apply to regions outside the Chinese mainland, including Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China). Valid values:
0: The Chinese mainland.
1: Regions outside the Chinese mainland, including Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China)
Overseas.description_zh: 是否为海外及港澳台权益：0 表示中国内地，1 表示海外及港澳台

RightsActiveFailureCause.description_en: The cause of the rights activation failure. This value may be empty if the activation is successful
RightsActiveFailureCause.description_zh: 权益激活失败原因；成功时可能为空
RightsActiveFailureCause.example: 镜像不可用，请选择可用镜像后重试

RightsActiveStatus.description_en: The rights activation status. Use the returned value to determine whether the activation is complete
RightsActiveStatus.description_zh: 权益激活状态，以返回值判断是否完成激活

RightsActiveTime.description_en: The time when the rights were activated. This value may be empty if the rights are not yet activated. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format and ends with Z
RightsActiveTime.description_zh: 权益激活时间；尚未激活时可能为空。采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 结尾

RightsAssignedUser.description_en: The end user to whom the rights are assigned. For convenience accounts, use EndUserId
RightsAssignedUser.description_zh: 权益分配的终端用户。便捷账号使用 EndUserId

RightsExpireTime.description_en: The deadline for manual activation of the rights. This is different from RightsResourceExpireTime, which is the expiration time of the resource after activation. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format and ends with Z
RightsExpireTime.description_zh: 权益手动激活截止时间，与激活后资源到期时间 RightsResourceExpireTime 区分。采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 结尾

RightsGpuSpec.description_en: The GPU specification. Refer to the returned value in the rights details
RightsGpuSpec.description_zh: GPU 规格，以权益详情返回值为准

RightsId.description_en: The rights ID. Use this value for activation. This is not the cloud computer resource ID
RightsId.description_zh: 权益 ID。激活时使用此值，不是云电脑资源 ID

RightsInventorySpec.description_en: The inventory specification corresponding to the rights

RightsResourceArea.description_en: The area to which the rights belong. This cannot replace the resource region in a new activation request
RightsResourceArea.description_zh: 权益所属大区；不能代替新激活请求的资源地域

RightsResourceExpireTime.description_en: The actual expiration time of the resource. This is different from the deadline for rights activation. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format and ends with Z
RightsResourceExpireTime.description_zh: 资源实际到期时间，与权益可激活截止时间不同。采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 结尾

RightsResourceId.description_en: The ID of the resource associated with the rights. This value is returned after the resource is created
RightsResourceId.description_zh: 权益关联的资源 ID；资源创建完成后返回

RightsResourceRegion.description_en: The region ID of the resource. This is configured separately from the POP request routing region
RightsResourceRegion.description_zh: 资源所在地域 ID，与 POP 请求路由地域分别设置

RightsResourceStatus.description_en: The status of the associated resource. Refer to the returned value for the actual status
RightsResourceStatus.description_zh: 关联资源的状态，以查询返回值为准

RightsResourceType.description_en: The rights resource type. Use Desktop for regular cloud computers. For other commodities, specify the actual rights type
RightsResourceType.description_zh: 权益资源类型。普通云电脑使用 Desktop；其他商品按权益实际类型传入

RightsSourceName.description_en: The name of the rights source

RightsSpec.description_en: The rights specification code. Refer to the rights query results for the actual value
RightsSpec.description_zh: 权益规格编码，以权益查询结果为准

SystemDiskSize.description_en: The size of the system cloud disk. Unit: GiB

ValuePackageInfos.description_en: The list of value-added feature information associated with the rights
ValuePackageInfos.description_zh: 权益关联的增值功能信息列表

Function.description_en: The content of the value-added feature
Function.example: 基础监控能力、实时监控、会话监控、应用管控

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of results per page. Specify a positive integer from 1 to 200
MaxResults.description_zh: 每页结果数量；建议传入 1 至 200 的正整数

Message.description_en: The description of the processing result. This is used for troubleshooting when a failure occurs
Message.description_zh: 处理结果说明；失败时用于辅助定位

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. An empty value indicates that the current query has ended. If the value is not empty, pass it exactly as it is in the next query. The example is for illustration purposes only
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页分页凭证。为空表示本次查询已结束；不为空时，在下一次查询中原样传入。示例仅用于说明

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. This is used to troubleshoot call issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于排查调用问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was processed successfully. A successful activation request does not mean that the resource has been created
Success.description_zh: 本次请求是否处理成功。激活请求成功不等同于资源已创建完成

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of rights that meet the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的权益总数
